question: What kind of vehicle is called the 'Ship of the Desert' because it walks easily on hot sand? 🐪
explanation: Super! Camels have special padded feet that help them walk comfortably on the hot desert sand! 🐪
hint: It has a hump on its back.

question: What do we call a very high piece of land that often has snow on top? ⛰️
explanation: Great job! Mountains are very tall, and the air gets super cold at the top! ❄️
hint: It reaches up high into the clouds.

question: What type of clothes do people wear in cold mountains to stay warm? 🥶
explanation: Awesome! Thick woolen clothes trap heat and keep our bodies cozy and warm in the snow! 🧣
hint: These clothes are made from sheep's wool.

question: What kind of roofs do houses in snowy mountains usually have? 🏠
explanation: Fantastic! Sloping roofs help heavy snow and rain slide right off the house easily! 🏂
hint: They look like a triangle shape.

question: Which animal helps carry heavy bags in cold, hilly areas? 🏔️
explanation: Perfect! Yaks have long, thick hair that keeps them warm while they walk on snowy mountains! 🐂
hint: It looks like a very furry cow.

question: What kind of land is flat, wide, and very good for farming? 🌾
explanation: Wonderful! Plains have flat land and good soil, making it easy to grow yummy crops! 🌽
hint: It is level ground without high hills.

question: Which machine do farmers use to plough the soil in flat plains? 🚜
explanation: Super! Tractors are strong machines that help farmers prepare the flat land quickly! 🧑‍🌾
hint: It has big wheels and drives in fields.

question: What do we call a very large area of land covered in dry sand? 🏜️
explanation: Great! Deserts get very little rain, so the ground is mostly dry sand and rocks! ☀️
hint: It is usually very hot and dusty here.

question: What is the weather usually like in a sandy desert? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! The sun shines brightly and there is very little rain, making deserts super hot! 🌡️
hint: You would feel very thirsty here.

question: Which special plant grows easily in hot, dry deserts? 🌵
explanation: Fantastic! A cactus stores water in its thick stem to survive without rain for a long time! 💧
hint: It has sharp thorns instead of leaves.

question: What do people wear in hot deserts to stay cool and comfortable? 🏜️
explanation: Super! Light cotton clothes let the wind pass through and keep the body cool in the hot sun! 🌬️
hint: These are light and soft clothes.

question: Why do houses in hot deserts have very thick mud walls? 🧱
explanation: Wonderful! Thick walls block the hot sun outside, keeping the inside of the house nice and cool! 🧊
hint: It acts like a shield against the heat.

question: What kind of roofs do houses in dry deserts usually have? ☀️
explanation: Great job! Since it rarely rains in the desert, they don't need sloping roofs to drain water! ☀️
hint: You can walk on top of these roofs.

question: Where do you find houses built high up on tall wooden poles? 🌧️
explanation: Awesome! In places with heavy rain, houses are raised to stay safely above the flood water! 🌊
hint: These poles are called stilts.

question: What are the tall wooden poles that hold up houses in rainy areas called? 🎋
explanation: Super! Stilts are strong wooden or bamboo poles that keep the house high and dry! 🏠
hint: They look like long legs for the house.

question: What material is very common for building stilt houses? 🎋
explanation: Fantastic! Bamboo grows well in wet areas and is light but very strong for building houses! 🎍
hint: It is a tall, green, woody plant.

question: What do we wear over our clothes to go outside in the rain? 🌧️
explanation: Wonderful! Raincoats are made of waterproof material that stops water from making us wet! 🌧️
hint: Water slips right off it.

question: Which landform is packed with many tall trees, plants, and wild animals? 🐅
explanation: Great job! Forests are home to thousands of animals and have thick green trees everywhere! 🌳
hint: Lions, tigers, and bears live here.

question: How do people travel across rivers in places with deep water? 🛶
explanation: Awesome! Boats float safely on top of the water, helping people go from one side to the other! 🌊
hint: You use oars to row it.

question: What is a cool house made entirely of hard snow blocks called? ❄️
explanation: Super! Igloos trap the heat inside, keeping people warm even when it is freezing outside! 🥶
hint: It looks like a white dome.

question: Where would you travel to see an igloo? 🥶
explanation: Fantastic! Igloos are only built in places covered with deep snow and freezing ice! 🧊
hint: You need a lot of snow to build one.

question: Which large animal has thick white fur to stay warm in the icy snow? 🐻‍❄️
explanation: Wonderful! Polar bears have thick fur and a layer of fat to stay cozy in the freezing cold! ❄️
hint: It is a huge, white bear.

question: What do village farmers grow in the soil of the flat plains? 🌾
explanation: Great job! Flat lands with good soil are perfect for growing crops like wheat, rice, and corn! 🚜
hint: We eat these every day.

question: Which animal pulls a wooden cart for farmers in village plains? 🐂
explanation: Awesome! Bullocks are very strong and help farmers carry goods in carts across the plains! 🌾
hint: It looks like a cow with big horns.

question: What do people use inside a mountain house to stay warm in winter? 🔥
explanation: Super! A heater or a cozy fireplace warms up the air inside the room when it's freezing outside! 🥶
hint: It makes things hot.

question: Which hot drink do people love to sip in very cold places? ☕
explanation: Fantastic! Drinking hot tea or warm soup helps heat up the body from the inside! 🍲
hint: It comes in a cup with steam rising.

question: What special shoes do people wear to walk comfortably on thick snow? 👢
explanation: Wonderful! Snow boots keep your feet warm, dry, and stop you from slipping on the icy snow! ❄️
hint: They are tall, thick, and warm.

question: What is a small, green patch with a water pool in a desert called? 🌴
explanation: Great job! An oasis is a beautiful spot in a desert where water comes up from underground! 💧
hint: You will find palm trees growing here.

question: Which trees grow tall and straight with needle-like leaves on cold mountains? 🌲
explanation: Awesome! Pine trees have needle leaves so snow can slide off easily without breaking their branches! ❄️
hint: They look like Christmas trees.

question: What object helps keep both the hot sun and heavy rain away from us? ☂️
explanation: Super! Opening an umbrella creates a tiny roof over our heads to keep us dry and cool! 🌧️
hint: It opens up like a colorful mushroom.

question: What do people use to travel super fast between different faraway lands? ✈️
explanation: Fantastic! Airplanes fly high in the sky and can cross mountains and oceans very quickly! ☁️
hint: It has wings and flies in the sky.

question: Where do people build long rope bridges to safely cross deep valleys? 🌉
explanation: Wonderful! Rope bridges help people easily cross from one mountain hill to another! 🚶
hint: It hangs high in the air between two hills.

question: Which vehicle moves smoothly over soft, white snow? 🛷
explanation: Great job! Sleds have smooth runners on the bottom instead of wheels, so they glide over the snow! ❄️
hint: Dogs often pull it in snowy lands.

question: Which bird loves to swim in the village ponds on the plains? 🦆
explanation: Awesome! Ducks have webbed feet that help them paddle in the calm waters of plain ponds! 🌊
hint: It goes 'quack quack'.

question: What forms the soft, dry ground that you walk on in a desert? 🏜️
explanation: Super! The heat and wind break rocks into tiny pieces of sand over many, many years! ☀️
hint: You play with it at the beach.

question: Which animal has long arms to easily swing through thick forest trees? 🐒
explanation: Fantastic! Monkeys are great climbers and love to swing from branch to branch looking for fruits! 🍌
hint: It loves eating bananas.

question: What is the floor of a thick forest usually covered with? 🍂
explanation: Wonderful! Leaves fall from the tall trees and make a soft, crunchy carpet on the forest floor! 🌳
hint: They fall from trees in autumn.

question: What materials are old village houses on the plains often made of? 🛖
explanation: Great job! Mud and straw are easy to find on farms and they keep the inside of the house very cool! 🌾
hint: These houses are brown like the earth.

question: What do farmers use to easily move goods in the desert? 🐪
explanation: Awesome! A camel can easily pull a cart full of goods across the hot, sandy desert! 🐫
hint: It is pulled by an animal with a hump.

question: What helps different vehicles travel smoothly across cities and plains? 🛣️
explanation: Super! Roads give cars, buses, and bikes a smooth and safe path to travel on! 🚗
hint: They are long, flat, and usually black.

question: What is the safest place for people to walk across a busy city road? 🚶
explanation: Fantastic! The black and white lines show cars where to stop so people can cross safely! 🚦
hint: It has black and white stripes.

question: What is a large body of fresh water often found surrounded by plains or hills? 🌊
explanation: Wonderful! Lakes are beautiful bodies of water where fish live and birds come to drink! 🐟
hint: It looks like a giant swimming pool in nature.

question: What natural object gives heat and light to all the different lands? ☀️
explanation: Great job! The sun is a giant star that warms the earth and helps plants grow everywhere! 🌻
hint: It shines bright yellow during the day.

question: In which place do people wear clothes made of sheep's wool? 🐑
explanation: Awesome! Wool traps body heat, making it perfect for snowy, cold mountain weather! 🧣
hint: It snows heavily here.

question: Where does cotton for cool desert clothes come from? 🌱
explanation: Super! Farmers grow cotton plants, and the fluffy white cotton is turned into comfortable clothes! 👕
hint: It looks like fluffy white clouds on a bush.

question: What is the main reason houses in heavy rain areas are built on stilts? 🌊
explanation: Fantastic! Stilts keep the house high above the ground, so flood water flows underneath without coming inside! ☔
hint: It keeps the floor perfectly dry.

question: Which animal loves to eat the prickly cactus plant in the desert? 🐪
explanation: Wonderful! Camels have tough mouths, so they can eat the prickly cactus to get water and food! 🌵
hint: It is called the ship of the desert.

question: What does snow look like when it covers a mountain? ❄️
explanation: Great job! Heavy snow covers everything in a beautiful layer of bright white ice! 🌨️
hint: It is the color of milk.

question: Which type of land has the most people living, working, and farming on it? 🏘️
explanation: Awesome! It is very easy to build houses, roads, and grow food on nice, flat land! 🚜
hint: It is smooth, level ground.

question: What makes our Wondrous World so beautiful and fun to learn about? 🌍
explanation: Super! Mountains, plains, deserts, and forests all have their own special magic and beauty! ✨
hint: Having many types of places.
